description: Read the Tail 2's live gimbal pose in degrees (yaw/pitch/roll) plus the zoom ratio. The API has no direct pose read — this works by saving the current pose into an empty preset slot, reading it back, and deleting the slot (takes ~2s). Requires at least one empty preset slot: overwriting a preset is irreversible (no pose-by-value write exists to restore it). Leftover 'pose-probe' slots from crashed reads are deleted, not trusted.
name: obsbot_tail2_gimbal_position
